title: Horn 子句前向链：Datalog 的最小实现
expected_output:
facts (parent):
  parent(tom, bob)
  parent(bob, ann)
  parent(bob, pat)
  parent(pat, jim)
round 1: + ancestor(tom, ann)   [parent(tom,bob) & ancestor(bob,ann)]
round 1: + ancestor(tom, pat)   [parent(tom,bob) & ancestor(bob,pat)]
round 1: + ancestor(bob, jim)   [parent(bob,pat) & ancestor(pat,jim)]
round 2: + ancestor(tom, jim)   [parent(tom,bob) & ancestor(bob,jim)]

rounds to fixpoint: 2, new facts derived: 4
all ancestors:
  ancestor(tom, bob)
  ancestor(tom, ann)
  ancestor(tom, pat)
  ancestor(tom, jim)

  ancestor(bob, pat)
  ancestor(bob, jim)

note: the recursion terminates because the relation is finite --
